**Needs changes before merge.** Two quick-gate steps are red on the trial merge with current `main`. The safety logic is correct, and the mutations show that the new tests pin it.

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes the "Do not touch" collision check of Trace operations.

### What looks good

- `protect_trace` keeps the cutting moves on the selected line. It lifts only upright rapid links (`route_links`). If any contact remains, it refuses the Trace and names the protected item. The decision record explains why the PR does not clip the path or only give a warning.
- The check runs after fixture routing (`generate.rs:3348-3352`). After it, the code adds only notes to a Trace path (`air_noted`, `top_stock`). No later step adds moves that the check does not see.
- `clearance_problems` now has one implementation, used by generation and by the live post gate (`live_avoid_problems`). The post gate still checks the cached Trace against the current protected geometry.
- `trace_protects_the_full_sweep_between_clear_endpoints` checks the holder band and the shank band between two clear endpoints. It also checks that a Trace that is clear, or has no protected items, keeps its original moves. It checks that a refused post writes no NC file.
- There is no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in non-test code. The provenance line is on the new test module. The decision file is present. The body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #3348`.

### Results (built locally, trial merge of `abed47739` with `upstream/main` `ef1572114`, merge `4e9197a3b`)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 339 steps, 337 ok, **2 FAIL**, 0 stalled (54.8 min).
  - `app suites: mcp_doc_drift`: FAIL (see item 1).
  - `ui suites: lib`: FAIL, `egui_app::tests::do_not_touch_click::trace_takes_a_protected_face_and_edge_by_viewport_click` (see item 2). The two other tests in that module pass.
  - Each other app suite passes. This includes `do_not_touch` (5/5), `example_catalog`, `golden_cl` and `posting`. Each other UI suite passes.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Extra suites run: none apply. The diff does not change `testdata/` or the importer code.
- Goldens moved: none. The diff changes no `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file.
- Heavy lanes: not run in this review, because the verdict has blockers. The heavy run in the body is on `abed47739` merged with an older `main` (`6679b1b4b`). It does not cover the trial tree against current `main`.

### Mutations (safety tier)

| Mutation | `do_not_touch` Trace tests |
|---|---|
| 1. Remove the `protect_trace` call in `generate.rs:3351` | both FAIL (red) |
| 2. `protect_trace` routes links but never refuses (`avoid.rs:260`) | both FAIL (red) |
| Restored head | both pass (green) |

### Requested before merge

1. **`docs/agents/mcp-tools.md:34` is out of date.** The PR adds "Trace" to the `set_operation_do_not_touch` description in `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:51`. The committed reference still says "2D Offset and 3D Pocket". `mcp_doc_drift` fails:
   ```
   panicked at crates/app/tests/mcp_doc_drift.rs:92:5:
   docs/agents/mcp-tools.md is out of date with the MCP tool table. Write it again with:
   cargo run -p camcraft-app --bin camcraft-cli -- mcp reference > docs/agents/mcp-tools.md
   ```
   Run that command and commit the new file.
2. **`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch_click.rs:48`: the new Trace click test fails on current `main`.**
   ```
   panicked at crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch_click.rs:68:5:
   assertion `left == right` failed: the group is armed
     left: None
    right: Some(DoNotTouch)
   ```
   The cause is in `main`, not in the PR logic. After the PR base, `main` added the "Outside boundary offset" row (#3338) and the start/exit "not taken" group (#3324). The Trace Geometry tab is now taller, and "Pick protected" is below the 1100 px harness window. `main` made the same change for `tests/do_not_touch.rs` (1100 to 1200 px, #3338). Locally, with the window set to 1440 x 1300 px, all three tests in the module pass. Merge `main` into the branch. Then make the harness window taller (or scroll to "Pick protected"), and run `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib do_not_touch_click` again.
3. After the fix, run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base main` on the new head against current `main`. Put the result in the body.

### Notes (not blocking)

- The PR changes no UI code. But the Trace page now shows the "Do not touch" controls in place of the "not supported" note. A before/after screenshot of the Trace Boundary group would help the maintainer.
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:168` still says that `set_operation_do_not_touch` applies to `2D Offset` and `3D Pocket` only. The Trace section of the user guide (`site/content/guide/operations/`) does not mention "Do not touch". A follow-up can correct the two texts.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
I moved this PR back to draft to fix the two failing checks on current `main`. I will regenerate the MCP reference and make the protected-geometry click test work with the taller Geometry tab.

- Conflict files: `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs`, `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`, `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md`. The resolution keeps the two sides: Face from `main` and Trace from this PR.

They are `do_not_touch`, `do_not_touch_face`, `mcp_doc_drift`, `first_part_programs`, the three `example_catalog*` suites, the three new `*_pass_start` suites, and all 13 UI steps. The `camcraft-ui` lib step passed 1474 tests.
- The other 319 app steps did not run again on the final head.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** The two earlier findings are fixed. All the tests that I ran on the trial merge with current `main` pass. This includes the heavy lanes.

This is a SAFETY-tier re-review: the PR changes the "Do not touch" collision check of Trace operations.

### Earlier findings (review of `abed47739`)

1. `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` was out of date. **Fixed.** The reference now lists "Trace, 2D Offset, 3D Pocket and Face", the same as `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:51`. `mcp_doc_drift` passes (6/6).
2. `trace_takes_a_protected_face_and_edge_by_viewport_click` failed on current `main`. **Fixed.** The test now scrolls "Pick protected" and the remove button into view before each click (`do_not_touch_click.rs:66`, `:94`). All three tests of the module pass.
3. Heavy run on the new head. **Met.** The rule of #3556 no longer asks a P3 PR for the heavy lanes. I ran them on this head anyway (see below), and they are green.

### Conflict resolution (merge `a26b7e16c`)

- The hand edits keep the two sides. `do_not_touch_applies` accepts `Offset2D`, `Pocket3D`, `Face` and `Trace` (`types/avoid.rs:53`). The refusal text and the MCP description name the same four kinds.
- The Face path from `main` is not changed. Trace takes its spec with `take_if` at `generate.rs:3426`. Thus the general upright route and verify (`generate.rs:3862`) and the tilted verify (`generate.rs:4014`) do not run a second time on a Trace. `protect_trace` already refuses each remaining contact.
- The Trace check still runs after fixture routing (`generate.rs:3410-3428`). The post gate (`live_avoid_problems`) still uses the shared `clearance_problems`.

### Results (built locally, trial merge of `6ad6311fa` with `upstream/main` `35940da16`, merge `1d955bc88`)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 347 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (41.5 min). This includes `do_not_touch`, `do_not_touch_face`, `mcp_doc_drift`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `posting` and all 13 UI steps (`ui suites: lib` included).
- Pinning tests by name:
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test do_not_touch`: 5 passed (the two `trace::` tests included).
  - `--test do_not_touch_face`: 3 passed. `--test mcp_doc_drift`: 6 passed.
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib do_not_touch`: 7 passed (the three `do_not_touch_click` tests included).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 3 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 212 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (29.2 min). The two registered known fails (#1950, #2849) were red as expected.
- Extra suites run: none apply. The diff does not change `testdata/` or the importer code.
- Goldens moved: none. The diff changes no `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file.

### Mutations (safety tier, on this tree)

| Mutation | `do_not_touch` Trace tests |
|---|---|
| 1. Remove the `protect_trace` call (`generate.rs:3427`) | both FAIL (red) |
| 2. `protect_trace` routes links but never refuses (`avoid.rs:260`) | both FAIL (red) |
| Restored tree | 5/5 pass (green) |

### Screenshots

The PR changes no UI code, only a UI test. The body has before and after screenshots of the Trace Geometry tab.

### Optional, non-blocking

- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` and the Trace page of the user guide do not yet name Trace for "Do not touch". A follow-up can correct the two texts.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Second read (read-only, not built) of head 6ad6311fa51dfd1acba6807460337970ece211dc. This comment has no review marker. I did not change a label.

Verdict: no blocker.

## What Trace does with protected items now
- Before this PR a Trace with "Do not touch" items was refused by name. Now the rapid links that are upright are lifted over protected items (the same `route_links` code and pad as the other kinds), and then the whole Trace is refused if a contact stays. A cutting move is never clipped or moved.
- The check tests each move: the cuts, the lead-in and lead-out, the plunges, the links and the last retract. It tests each part of the tool: flutes, shank and holder. The sweep is continuous along each move, not sampled. It runs on the final path, so the side offset and the depth below the curve are in it. The post gate checks the cached path again.

## Gouge check
- A traced curve on a protected item is refused by name. The same edge chain in the two lists is refused as an overlap.
- An item above the cut is found: the holder is in the tool body. The pin checks a holder reach of 14.9 mm against 15 mm.
- In a tilted setup the items are in the frame of the job. A tilted rapid that meets an item refuses the Trace: the safe direction.
- A blocked Trace refuses fully. No shorter path with a note comes from it.
- With no protected items nothing runs, and the path is that of `main`. No golden and no catalog program is in the diff.

## Shared code
The merge with the Face change of #3413 kept the two sides. Contour, 2D Pocket, Adaptive, Finish 3D and Engrave keep their refusal. The MCP change is description text only. The ui test count goes up by one. No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. `generate.rs` grows by 5 lines; the logic is in `avoid.rs`.

## Notes, not blockers (filed as https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3594)
- The refusal names only the first item.
- No pin for a clear tilted case.
- The approach from the tool change position is made in the post and is outside this check, as for the whole family.

## Not checked
I did not build. The trial merge with the current `main` runs here before the merge: `do_not_touch`, `do_not_touch_face`, `do_not_touch_project`, the Trace binaries, the `mcp` binaries with `mcp_doc_drift`, the ui lib tests, `golden_cl`, `conformance`, the example suites and `first_part_programs`.
